hypotheses.D0_analytic_selector_matches_finite_rank: Per-example analytic quotient selection agrees with the finite rank-1 winner at least 95% of the time in every family/split.
hypotheses.D1_terminal_positive_support_is_sparse: For complete head effects, median positive effective support is at most three and median largest-positive share is at least one half in every family/split.
hypotheses.D2_one_family_head_explains_most_example: The split-0 aggregate winner is also the per-example finite rank-1 winner for at least half of split-1 examples in each family.
hypotheses.D3_context_only_dynamic_selection_is_use: The largest routed rank-1 write selects the finite rank-1 winner at least half the time and captures at least 70% of oracle positive effect in every family/split.
hypotheses.D4_output_conditioned_dynamic_selection_: The analytic quotient selector captures at least 95% of oracle positive finite rank-1 effect in every family/split.
hypotheses.D5_weight_rank1_preserves_complete_head_: Per-example rank-1 and complete-head effects have median within-example Pearson correlation at least 0.7 and agree on the winning head at least half the time in every family/split.
